text: EX-004: gaps found. Please revisit: (1) e2e/differentViews.spec.js — this file contains a test.skip(MODERN_CLIENT) guard showing the widget is NOT supported in the Mendix React client; this platform incompatibility constraint is entirely absent from the draft and must be captured. (2) e2e/dataTypes.spec.js — badge value binds to integer, long, and decimal attribute types (not just string); the test shows locale-aware formatting (e.g., 2,147,483,647 with comma separators) — document this as a behavioral constraint on the value property. (3) e2e/onClick.spec.js — confirm all supported action types (microflow, nanoflow, open page, open modal popup, close page) are reflected in the draft. Add a section for each e2e file following the same 5-question format.
